title: 第19章 人身上的三把阳火第20章 细水长流的生意
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
而武人则不同，每一个境界的提升其战斗力都会有非常直观的变化。
“还是先提升自保能力吧，慕璃也才锻骨境，战斗力已经非常可观了……”
心念一动，精粹便加在了蛰龙吐纳法上，‘第一周天’渐渐模糊，被‘第二周天’所取代。
呼~~
霎时间，顾铮感觉体内内息迅速壮大，就像是充气一样，不到十秒钟就充斥全身，贯通四肢百骸，于五脏六腑，筋骨皮膜之中，吐火如荼的强壮骨骼。
如果有人在旁边，可以听到好似河流奔腾一般的声音从他身体中响起，而他整个身体也像是化身火炉，冒出腾腾热气。
一种巨大的变化正在他身体内部发生。
“这变化……”
虽然有所准备，但这巨大的变化还是让顾铮颇为吃惊，伸手拔出苗刀冲进院中兴奋的舞刀。
刀光如匹练不断的闪烁，顾铮刀势变化很快，体内的内息狂暴的涌动，渗入筋骨肌肉中，迅速的强化着身体。
以整个晚上，顾铮都一动不动，体会着身体的蜕变，内息运转不停，游走全身，淬炼浑身筋骨。
直到日暮散去，顾铮才收刀而立，全身上下爆发出噼里啪啦的声音。
“力道贯穿全身筋骨，我进入锻骨境了！”
细细体会着身体的变化，顾铮可以清晰的感受到了自身的力量有了一个爆炸性的增长，他再也忍耐不住，右手五指合拢，猛地一拳轰出。
嘭！
大筋好似被压缩到极致的弹簧弹抖，拳头带着强大洞穿力，空气被强大的力量狠狠挤压，发出嘭的一声。
“我现在，好猛！”
顾铮大笑，在院中闪腾挪移挥拳。
呼呼呼！
他的拳脚掀起的劲风四处激荡，院中风声爆响不绝于耳。

砰砰砰！
他脚下每一步踏出，地砖都剧烈震动，仿佛承受不住他足下爆发的力量，甚至有几块地砖上浮现出裂缝，可见他此时的力量有多么庞大。
“全身大筋绷紧如弓弦，打人如开弓，中拳如中箭，骨骼似铁，洞穿力强大，这就是锻骨境！我现在的力量，保守也有上千斤！”
感受着强劲的身体和通达全身的内息，顾铮双拳紧握，开始无限畅想武道后面的境界会有多强大。
实力暴增，顾铮心中欢喜，良久之后才平复心情。
“晋升锻骨境消耗了两点精粹，不知道晋升练脏境需要几点？如果是等差就是三点，如果是倍数就是四点，或者没有规律，那就无法推断了。”
“只不过……”
顾铮念头一动，铜镜上的属性面板浮现了出来：
【顾铮——】
【功法：神明食气录（第一层）+，蛰龙吐纳法（第二周天），大泼风刀（初窥门径）+，大洞符箓真经（未入门）+，登真隐法（未入门）+】
【精粹：1】
喜悦的心情消失的无影无踪，顾铮心头泛起淡淡的忧愁：
“只剩下1点精粹了，想获得精粹只能去找妖魔鬼怪了……现在的问题是，哪里有妖魔鬼怪呢？”
轻叹一声，提着刀往屋里走去。
“嗯？”
【苗刀+】
content_en:
But warriors are different, their combat effectiveness will change very intuitively as each level improves.
"It's better to improve your self-protection ability first. Mu Li is only at the bone forging stage, and her combat effectiveness is already very impressive..."
With a thought, the essence was added to the Hidden Dragon Breathing Method, and the 'first week' gradually became blurred and was replaced by the 'second week'.
Phew~~
In an instant, Gu Zheng felt that the breath in his body was rapidly growing, like inflating, filling his whole body in less than ten seconds, penetrating through his limbs and bones, breathing out strong bones like fire in his internal organs, muscles and skin.
If someone is nearby, you can hear a sound like a rushing river coming from his body, and his whole body seems to be transformed into a furnace, with steam rising.
A huge change was taking place inside his body.
"This change..."
Although he was prepared, this huge change still surprised Gu Zheng. He reached out and pulled out the Miao Dao and rushed into the courtyard to dance with his sword excitedly.
The light of the sword flashed like a sword. Gu Zheng's sword force changed rapidly. The internal energy in his body surged violently, seeping into the bones and muscles, rapidly strengthening the body.
For the entire night, Gu Zheng remained motionless, feeling the transformation of his body. His inner breath was constantly circulating, traveling throughout his body and tempering his muscles and bones.
It wasn't until the sunset that Gu Zheng sheathed his sword and stood up, crackling sounds erupted from all over his body.
"The strength penetrates all the muscles and bones of my body, I have entered the bone forging realm!"
Feeling the changes in his body carefully, Gu Zheng could clearly feel that his strength had exploded. He couldn't bear it anymore, he closed the five fingers of his right hand and punched out fiercely.
Bang!
The big tendons vibrated like springs that had been compressed to the extreme. The fists had strong piercing power, and the air was squeezed hard by the powerful force, making a banging sound.
"I'm so fierce now!"
Gu Zheng laughed, moving around in the courtyard and pumping his fists.
Hoo ho ho!
The strong wind stirred up by his fists and kicks stirred up in all directions, and the sound of wind and explosions could be heard constantly in the courtyard.
Bang bang bang!
With every step he took, the floor tiles shook violently, as if they could not withstand the power of his steps. There were even cracks on some of the floor tiles, which showed how powerful his power was at this time.
"The muscles in the whole body are as tight as a bow string, hitting people is like drawing a bow, hitting a punch is like hitting an arrow, the bones are like iron, and the piercing power is strong. This is the bone forging realm! My current strength is estimated to be over a thousand kilograms!"
Feeling the strong body and the inner energy that penetrated the whole body, Gu Zheng clenched his fists and began to endlessly imagine how powerful the realm behind martial arts would be.
Gu Zheng was delighted with his sudden increase in strength, and it took him a long time to calm down.
"It consumes two points of essence to advance to the bone forging realm. I wonder how many points are needed to advance to the internal organs training realm? If it is an equal difference, it will be three points. If it is a multiple, it will be four points. Or if there is no pattern, then it cannot be inferred."
"It's just..."
As Gu Zheng thought, the attribute panel on the bronze mirror appeared:
【Gu Zheng——】
[Exercise techniques: God's Food Qi Record (first level)+, Hidden Dragon Breathing Method (second week), Big Splashing Wind Knife (first glimpse of the door)+, Big Cave Talisman Sutra (not yet started)+, Dengzhen Hidden Technique (not yet started)+]
【Quality: 1】
The joyful mood disappeared without a trace, and a faint sadness filled Gu Zheng's heart:
"There is only 1 point of essence left. If you want to get the essence, you can only find the monsters... The question now is, where are the monsters?"
Sighing softly, he walked towards the house with the knife in hand.
"Huh?"
【Miao Dao+】
